answer_1.quote: The current large-scale pretrained neural machine translation (NMT) models, such as GMNMT , mBART50-nn , and M2M-100 , are generally trained with large amounts of data from different domains and languages, so the model can learn good semantic representation and mapping relationship at the same time.

answer_2.quote: The final translation is evaluated using the 4-gram case-sensitive BLEU  with the SacreBLEU tool . Following , we report the SentencePiece BLEU which uses a SentencePiece tokenizer (SPM) with 256K tokens and then BLEU score is computed on the sentence-piece tokenized text .
